text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you know? In the upcoming mock 
race I'm running in... all of our 
batchmates will be there too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft with her unmatched front-running 
drive, Cesario with her overwhelming late 
charge, and Messiah with her steady, 
diligent efforts—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's taking their races so 
seriously, all to claim the Tiara. ...They 
truly are strong Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ I'm so glad I came to this 
country!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To compete against and triumph over 
rivals who truly desire the Tiara—that is 
what makes a true 'Queen'!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I won't back down! —The queen's throne is 
mine!"
